subject: Request: make-good months for ClearPath throughput incident
messages:
From: Alicia Turner <alicia.turner@clearpath.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@clearpath.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Sustained throughput degradation Aug 10-16 — request for remediation

Hi Ben,

We saw sustained throughput drops on our production endpoints between Aug 10 and Aug 16. Latency spiked intermittently and our tail latency increased by ~3.2x on average for heavy bursts; one job queue timed out twice and required manual retry. Ops attached a short incident report and usage summary.

This impacted peak traffic for our checkout flow and caused a roughly 12% revenue drop for that week (our internal estimate). Our finance and procurement teams are asking what remediation/redress Redwood can provide under the SLA — specifically, whether you can provide service makeup (free months) or a pro-rated refund to offset the lost capacity.

Can you escalate and confirm whether an executive concession is possible? We need something to present to our CFO by next Monday.

Thanks,
Alicia Turner
Head of Platform Engineering
ClearPath Inc.

Attachments: clearpath_incident_report_20260815.pdf; usage-summary-aug10-17.csv
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Turner <alicia.turner@clearpath.com>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sustained throughput degradation Aug 10-16 — request for remediation

Alicia — thanks for the detailed report and for flagging the CFO timeline. I've looped in Soojin (Head of Customer Ops) and Karthik (Revenue Ops) to scope options and quantify the impact.

Short answers up front: we can escalate for an exec-level make-good, but approvals differ depending on the relief structure (free months vs. one-time credit vs. hybrid). To propose something concrete to your CFO, could you confirm:
- Confirmed weekly recurring spend on Redwood (approx) and the plan type (Dedicated vs Hosted)?
- Whether you need capacity replacement (extra throughput) or purely financial remediation?

I'll compile numbers and a recommended ask for Marissa (our Head of Sales Ops) to sign off.

-Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

> On Thu, Aug 20, 2026 at 9:12 AM Alicia Turner <alicia.turner@clearpath.com> wrote:
> > [attached] clearpath_incident_report_20260815.pdf
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Turner <alicia.turner@clearpath.com>, ops@clearpath.com
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposed remediation structure for ClearPath — need Marissa exec signoff

Hi team — pulled together a recommended offer based on the incident report and usage. Key facts:
- Customer runs Dedicated pool with a monthly committed spend of roughly $120k.
- Aug 10–16 incident appears to have reduced effective throughput by ~25% during peak windows for their top two endpoints.
- Estimated documented business impact: ~12% weekly revenue decline for the affected week (per ClearPath analysis).

Recommendation (aim for customer retention and quick CFO approval):
1) Offer one (1) complimentary month of Dedicated service applied to their next invoice (value ~ $120k) plus
2) A $10,000 one-time account credit to cover merchant costs and remediation effort.

Rationale: this is a heavier concession than we typically give, but ClearPath is a strategic mid-market account with expansion potential and a multi-year roadmap. We should treat this as a renew/retain concession, not a precedent for recurring discounts.

Conditions:
- One-time only (explicitly excluded from future renewals).
- Customer signs a short amendment acknowledging incident dates and accepting the offer; no other SLA disputes remain.
- Offer contingent on Marissa Cole's approval (I recommend approval limited to one month + $10k).

Attachments: proposed-makeup-offer-deck.pdf

If Marissa signs off, Ben can send the offer as a DocuSign amendment and I'll coordinate billing.

Thanks,
Soojin
Head of Customer Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Alicia Turner <alicia.turner@clearpath.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 15:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed remediation structure for ClearPath — need Marissa exec signoff

Ben / Soojin — I reviewed the incident summary and proposed terms. Approved with the following limits:
1) Approve one (1) complimentary month applied to the next billing cycle (no cash refund).
2) Approve a $7,500 one-time account credit (reduced from $10k) to balance retention economics.
3) Legal to prepare a one-page amendment limiting the concession to the Aug 10–16 incident and confirming this is not precedent for future outages.

Please proceed: Ben, send an amendment via DocuSign to Alicia and ops@clearpath.com. Soojin, coordinate billing and ensure the amendment references the incident report we have on file. Karthik, flag the deal for retention adjustments in HubSpot and mark deal CP-4921 as "make-good-processed."

Marissa Cole
SVP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
